Where it fits

The control layer of a room i9 plans.

In i9’s room planner, a lighting plan with scenes is built on Visual Productions: the CueCore3 runs it, the Wall-Mount Touch Screen sits by the door or in the booth, and the DIN Rail DMX RDM Relay switches the fixtures’ power.

The same controller is the last link of the integrator chain, after routing, conversion, the AV network and Dante audio, and it is in the control room: routing, dante and show control setup.

Other models from the range (B-Station2, CueCore2, QuadCore, NetPanel, RdmNode, Cuety LPU-1 / LPU-2, DaliCore) are not listed on the store yet. Ask, and the team checks them with the brand.

Visual Productions questions.

Availability in the USA, model names, projects and accounts.

Does i9Store sell Visual Productions in the USA?

Yes. i9 represents Visual Productions, and 8 of its products are listed on i9store.com/usa with USD prices, shipped from Miami.

Is the Wall-Mount Touch Screen the KioscTouch2?

Yes. The store lists Visual Productions’ KioscTouch2 wall screen under the name “Wall-Mount Touch Screen”.

What is the CueCore3 used for?

It is a multi-protocol architectural lighting controller: it runs lighting scenes and show triggers for a room, a church or a venue, with a wall screen or panel for the people who use the room.

Can I order a Visual Productions model that isn’t listed?

Ask. Models such as the B-Station2, QuadCore or RdmNode are not on the store yet; the i9 team checks them with the brand and quotes.

Do integrators and resellers get an account?

Apply with the form on this page. The i9 team reviews reseller and integrator accounts and replies with the terms.
